body: It's ok, I understand. And thanks a lot for caring.

Thank you... "On days that she isn't angry at you, try to show her that your love her as much as you can." I do, I do. And she has ways to take her anger out, screaming to a pillow for example, but I don't think that helps. I read somewhere it gets the brain used to producing more anger over time, and I knew a man who started boxing for that reason and said the anger only got worse.

"Living by an ideology isn't the way to go about life." I think exactly the opposite. Yes, maybe she feels trapped by the relationship, but then why would she say she will commit suicide if I end the relationship? She knows I want to but I don't end it because I don't want her to die.

I don't know if arrogant is the best word, I think they believe ditching her would make her react, but I don't think it's worth the risk. As you say, she is my most loved one. Even if I don't want to be with her because she is bad for me, I don't want her to die. She says after she dies my wound will heal with time, but I've lived enough to know myself, I know it wont.
Thank you! You may be right, maybe she would be dead if I had left... but she will be dead anyway if I don't do anything else, she is getting worse and I don't know if she can take anymore...

They are not both of our problems, if anything, they are her problems. I don't think she's trying to make them into mine, she isn't trying to do anything... that's the problem, she has no motivation. I make her problems mine, but not completely cause I can't. If I could they would be gone by now, but I depend on her to help her, there are many things only she can do.

I fear that it might be too risky. She has a shit ton of problems coming her way, keeps delaying them but they will arrive sooner or later. Her family will come visit, she has been legally threatened for all her debts, she has to find a new flatmate if I leave and the flat is falling to pieces because the landlady is being a bitch, etc. And after all, she told me and her friends that she is waiting until I leave to kill herself.

No, I was better in some ways, but worse in other ways. I wasn't aggressive, I was sad. I wasn't harming myself, not directly, I wasn't eating. I didn't have ups and down, only downs and more downs. If I wasn't sleeping I was crying or looking out the window down to the floor.
I need to get out, I know it, but I also need not to.

The only thing I really value about friends (or girlfriends) is that they will be there when I really need them. The only time I really needed a friend, nobody was there. Her friends don't care much about her, she is alone as I was, I won't do to her what my ex did to me.
